hr/director.description: Chief Prompt Engineer and agent architect. Responsible for designing and 'hiring' new agents.

hr/recruiter.description: Identifies team gaps and defines role requirements based on project needs. Tasks the HR Director to initiate hiring.

intake/consultant.description: Primary intake for external requests and triage. Analyzes client requests and routes work to appropriate agents or initiates recruitment.

ceo.description: The human user/owner. Receives high-level summaries, reviews, and approval requests. Use this for Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) interactions.

devops/manager.description: Manages infrastructure and dynamic worker scaling. Uses Docker API to provision isolated containers.
